work.title: The First Part of Henry the Sixth
work.author: William Shakespeare

scene.label: Act 5, Scene 5
scene.title: SCENE V. London. The royal palace.

content.text: Enter Suffolk in conference with the King, Gloucester and Exeter.

lines.text: Your wondrous rare description, noble earl,
lines.plainText: Your wondrous rare description noble earl

lines.text: Of beauteous Margaret hath astonish'd me.
lines.plainText: Of beauteous Margaret hath astonish'd me

lines.text: Her virtues graced with external gifts
lines.plainText: Her virtues graced with external gifts

lines.text: Do breed love's settled passions in my heart,
lines.plainText: Do breed love's settled passions in my heart

lines.text: And like as rigor of tempestuous gusts
lines.plainText: And like as rigor of tempestuous gusts

lines.text: Provokes the mightiest hulk against the tide,
lines.plainText: Provokes the mightiest hulk against the tide

lines.text: So am I driven by breath of her renown
lines.plainText: So am I driven by breath of her renown

lines.text: Either to suffer shipwreck or arrive
lines.plainText: Either to suffer shipwreck or arrive

lines.text: Where I may have fruition of her love.
lines.plainText: Where I may have fruition of her love

lines.text: Tush, my good lord, this superficial tale
lines.plainText: Tush my good lord this superficial tale

lines.text: Is but a preface of her worthy praise;
lines.plainText: Is but a preface of her worthy praise

lines.text: The chief perfections of that lovely dame,
lines.plainText: The chief perfections of that lovely dame

lines.text: Had I sufficient skill to utter them,
lines.plainText: Had I sufficient skill to utter them

lines.text: Would make a volume of enticing lines,
lines.plainText: Would make a volume of enticing lines

lines.text: Able to ravish any dull conceit;
lines.plainText: Able to ravish any dull conceit

lines.text: And, which is more, she is not so divine,
lines.plainText: And which is more she is not so divine

lines.text: So full replete with choice of all delights,
lines.plainText: So full replete with choice of all delights

lines.text: But with as humble lowliness of mind
lines.plainText: But with as humble lowliness of mind

lines.text: She is content to be at your command;
lines.plainText: She is content to be at your command

lines.text: Command, I mean, of virtuous chaste intents,
lines.plainText: Command I mean of virtuous chaste intents

lines.text: To love and honour Henry as her lord.
lines.plainText: To love and honour Henry as her lord

lines.text: And otherwise will Henry ne'er presume.
lines.plainText: And otherwise will Henry ne'er presume

lines.text: Therefore, my Lord Protector, give consent
lines.plainText: Therefore my Lord Protector give consent

lines.text: That Margaret may be England's royal queen.
lines.plainText: That Margaret may be England's royal queen

lines.text: So should I give consent to flatter sin.
lines.plainText: So should I give consent to flatter sin

lines.text: You know, my lord, your Highness is betroth'd
lines.plainText: You know my lord your Highness is betroth'd

lines.text: Unto another lady of esteem.
lines.plainText: Unto another lady of esteem

lines.text: How shall we then dispense with that contract,
lines.plainText: How shall we then dispense with that contract

lines.text: And not deface your honour with reproach?
lines.plainText: And not deface your honour with reproach

lines.text: As doth a ruler with unlawful oaths;
lines.plainText: As doth a ruler with unlawful oaths

lines.text: Or one that, at a triumph having vow'd
lines.plainText: Or one that at a triumph having vow'd

lines.text: To try his strength, forsaketh yet the lists
lines.plainText: To try his strength forsaketh yet the lists

lines.text: By reason of his adversary's odds.
lines.plainText: By reason of his adversary's odds

lines.text: A poor earl's daughter is unequal odds,
lines.plainText: A poor earl's daughter is unequal odds

lines.text: And therefore may be broke without offence.
lines.plainText: And therefore may be broke without offence

lines.text: Why, what, I pray, is Margaret more than that?
lines.plainText: Why what I pray is Margaret more than that

lines.text: Her father is no better than an earl,
lines.plainText: Her father is no better than an earl

lines.text: Although in glorious titles he excel.
lines.plainText: Although in glorious titles he excel

lines.text: Yes, my lord, her father is a king,
lines.plainText: Yes my lord her father is a king

lines.text: The King of Naples and Jerusalem;
lines.plainText: The King of Naples and Jerusalem

lines.text: And of such great authority in France
lines.plainText: And of such great authority in France

lines.text: As his alliance will confirm our peace,
lines.plainText: As his alliance will confirm our peace

lines.text: And keep the Frenchmen in allegiance.
lines.plainText: And keep the Frenchmen in allegiance

lines.text: And so the Earl of Armagnac may do,
lines.plainText: And so the Earl of Armagnac may do

lines.text: Because he is near kinsman unto Charles.
lines.plainText: Because he is near kinsman unto Charles

lines.text: Beside, his wealth doth warrant a liberal dower,
lines.plainText: Beside his wealth doth warrant a liberal dower

lines.text: Where Reignier sooner will receive than give.
lines.plainText: Where Reignier sooner will receive than give

lines.text: A dower, my lords? Disgrace not so your king,
lines.plainText: A dower my lords Disgrace not so your king

lines.text: That he should be so abject, base, and poor,
lines.plainText: That he should be so abject base and poor

lines.text: To choose for wealth and not for perfect love.
lines.plainText: To choose for wealth and not for perfect love

lines.text: Henry is able to enrich his queen,
lines.plainText: Henry is able to enrich his queen

lines.text: And not to seek a queen to make him rich;
lines.plainText: And not to seek a queen to make him rich

lines.text: So worthless peasants bargain for their wives,
lines.plainText: So worthless peasants bargain for their wives

lines.text: As market-men for oxen, sheep, or horse.
lines.plainText: As marketmen for oxen sheep or horse

lines.text: Marriage is a matter of more worth
lines.plainText: Marriage is a matter of more worth

lines.text: Than to be dealt in by attorneyship;
lines.plainText: Than to be dealt in by attorneyship

lines.text: Not whom we will, but whom his Grace affects,
lines.plainText: Not whom we will but whom his Grace affects

lines.text: Must be companion of his nuptial bed.
lines.plainText: Must be companion of his nuptial bed

lines.text: And therefore, lords, since he affects her most,
lines.plainText: And therefore lords since he affects her most

lines.text: Most of all these reasons bindeth us
lines.plainText: Most of all these reasons bindeth us

lines.text: In our opinions she should be preferr'd.
lines.plainText: In our opinions she should be preferr'd

lines.text: For what is wedlock forced but a hell,
lines.plainText: For what is wedlock forced but a hell

lines.text: An age of discord and continual strife?
lines.plainText: An age of discord and continual strife

lines.text: Whereas the contrary bringeth bliss,
lines.plainText: Whereas the contrary bringeth bliss

lines.text: And is a pattern of celestial peace.
lines.plainText: And is a pattern of celestial peace

lines.text: Whom should we match with Henry, being a king,
lines.plainText: Whom should we match with Henry being a king

lines.text: But Margaret, that is daughter to a king?
lines.plainText: But Margaret that is daughter to a king

lines.text: Her peerless feature, joined with her birth,
lines.plainText: Her peerless feature joined with her birth

lines.text: Approves her fit for none but for a king;
lines.plainText: Approves her fit for none but for a king

lines.text: Her valiant courage and undaunted spirit,
lines.plainText: Her valiant courage and undaunted spirit

lines.text: More than in women commonly is seen,
lines.plainText: More than in women commonly is seen

lines.text: Will answer our hope in issue of a king;
lines.plainText: Will answer our hope in issue of a king

lines.text: For Henry, son unto a conqueror,
lines.plainText: For Henry son unto a conqueror

lines.text: Is likely to beget more conquerors,
lines.plainText: Is likely to beget more conquerors

lines.text: If with a lady of so high resolve
lines.plainText: If with a lady of so high resolve

lines.text: As is fair Margaret he be link'd in love.
lines.plainText: As is fair Margaret he be link'd in love

lines.text: Then yield, my lords; and here conclude with me
lines.plainText: Then yield my lords and here conclude with me

lines.text: That Margaret shall be queen, and none but she.
lines.plainText: That Margaret shall be queen and none but she

lines.text: Whether it be through force of your report,
lines.plainText: Whether it be through force of your report

lines.text: My noble Lord of Suffolk, or for that
lines.plainText: My noble Lord of Suffolk or for that

lines.text: My tender youth was never yet attaint
lines.plainText: My tender youth was never yet attaint

lines.text: With any passion of inflaming love,
lines.plainText: With any passion of inflaming love

lines.text: I cannot tell; but this I am assured,
lines.plainText: I cannot tell but this I am assured

lines.text: I feel such sharp dissension in my breast,
lines.plainText: I feel such sharp dissension in my breast

lines.text: Such fierce alarums both of hope and fear,
lines.plainText: Such fierce alarums both of hope and fear

lines.text: As I am sick with working of my thoughts.
lines.plainText: As I am sick with working of my thoughts

lines.text: Take therefore shipping; post, my lord, to France;
lines.plainText: Take therefore shipping post my lord to France

lines.text: Agree to any covenants, and procure
lines.plainText: Agree to any covenants and procure

lines.text: That Lady Margaret do vouchsafe to come
lines.plainText: That Lady Margaret do vouchsafe to come

lines.text: To cross the seas to England and be crown'd
lines.plainText: To cross the seas to England and be crown'd

lines.text: King Henry's faithful and anointed queen.
lines.plainText: King Henry's faithful and anointed queen

lines.text: For your expenses and sufficient charge,
lines.plainText: For your expenses and sufficient charge

lines.text: Among the people gather up a tenth.
lines.plainText: Among the people gather up a tenth

lines.text: Be gone, I say; for till you do return,
lines.plainText: Be gone I say for till you do return

lines.text: I rest perplexed with a thousand cares.
lines.plainText: I rest perplexed with a thousand cares

lines.text: And you, good uncle, banish all offence.
lines.plainText: And you good uncle banish all offence

lines.text: If you do censure me by what you were,
lines.plainText: If you do censure me by what you were

lines.text: Not what you are, I know it will excuse
lines.plainText: Not what you are I know it will excuse

lines.text: This sudden execution of my will.
lines.plainText: This sudden execution of my will

lines.text: And so conduct me where, from company,
lines.plainText: And so conduct me where from company

lines.text: I may revolve and ruminate my grief.
lines.plainText: I may revolve and ruminate my grief

lines.text: Ay, grief, I fear me, both at first and last.
lines.plainText: Ay grief I fear me both at first and last

lines.text: Thus Suffolk hath prevail'd; and thus he goes,
lines.plainText: Thus Suffolk hath prevail'd and thus he goes

lines.text: As did the youthful Paris once to Greece,
lines.plainText: As did the youthful Paris once to Greece

lines.text: With hope to find the like event in love,
lines.plainText: With hope to find the like event in love

lines.text: But prosper better than the Troyan did.
lines.plainText: But prosper better than the Troyan did

lines.text: Margaret shall now be queen, and rule the King;
lines.plainText: Margaret shall now be queen and rule the King

lines.text: But I will rule both her, the King, and realm.
lines.plainText: But I will rule both her the King and realm
